title: Tim Taylor and the 'adjustment team'

tellings.quote: And then there's Tim Taylor telling Pasulka that he was part of the quote-unquote adjustment team,

plain: A man named Timothy Taylor, linked to NASA, is said to have told the religious studies scholar Diana Pasulka that he was part of the "adjustment team," which suggests a hidden group working behind the scenes. Michels relays this second-hand from Pasulka, without saying what the team did.
